text:
maya: Quick design review: I pushed the updated scorecard legend prototypes to Figma. Main ask — can we confirm the focus order for keyboard users?
kevin: Saw them, thanks. My main concern is the color coding for 'regression' vs 'unexpected change' — low contrast on the yellow badge at 14px.
olivia: Yep +1 on contrast. Also the legend items need clear text labels not just icons. Screen-reader users shouldn't rely on color.
maya: Agreed. Proposed copy: 'Regression (behavior changed from baseline)' and 'Unexpected (output differs from expectation)'. Thoughts?
sam: I like the longer copy for a11y. Suggest we keep a short label visually and add an accessible name via aria-label with the longer string.
kevin: That works. On focus order — currently tab goes: filters -> run selector -> each test row -> scorecard. We want keyboard to jump to the selected test details after you open a test, not to the next row.
olivia: For clarity: after Enter on a row we should trap focus inside the test detail panel, first element being the playback controls, then the diff toggle, then 'Mark as pass/fail' button. Escape closes and returns focus to the triggering row.
maya: Nice. Sam can we prototype the focus trap? Also small copy tweak: change 'Approve' to 'Mark as Expected' and 'Reject' to 'Mark as Regression' — want language explicit about intent.
sam: I'll prototype. One nit: 'Mark as Regression' reads strong, maybe 'Flag as Regression' is softer.
kevin: +1 to 'Flag as Regression'. Also keyboard users need an announced context when we open a detail panel: `aria-live="polite"` with "Opened test: <test name>".
olivia: For visual affordances, let's also add a 2px inset outline on focusable controls (not just box-shadow). Designers: can we get a token for that?
maya: I'll add token in Figma. Accessibility checklist item: (1) readable contrast >=4.5:1, (2) aria-labels on badges, (3) focus trap behavior, (4) escape restores focus.
aria-bot: A11y checklist created: https://internal/a11y/1901234567 — status: todo.
sam: Prototype ready by EOD tomorrow, I'll include a short demo GIF and the `tab` order plan.
maya: Thanks. One last UI question — bulk-approve flow: if we change wording from 'Approve' to 'Mark as Expected' we should also update the bulk modal header and confirmation copy to explain effect (e.g., updates baseline vs annotates current run).
kevin: Good call. Add a small link to docs in the modal: 'How baselines and expectations work'.
olivia: And please ensure the bulk modal has keyboard shortcuts info (e.g., press Enter to confirm, Esc to cancel) visible at the bottom for power users.
maya: Great, circling back after Sam's prototype. If anyone has strong objections to the copy changes speak now. Otherwise I'll update the spec. :thumbsup:
